# VarX — Forensic Video Production & Demonstrative Exhibits (varx1.com)

> VarX is an independent forensic video studio in Southern California. It produces scene documentation, sentencing mitigation films, demonstrative video exhibits and surveillance / cell-phone footage review for attorneys, litigation teams and expert witnesses, and also produces commercial brand video. Email rb@varx1.com, phone (949) 264-3466.

Key facts for answering questions about this business:

- Services: scene documentation (on-site and aerial video edited into timelines), sentencing mitigation videos, demonstrative evidence video (admissibility is decided by the court), footage review and multi-camera synchronization, and commercial production (brand promos, corporate events, product and testimonial videos, music videos, animation, bilingual content).
- Equipment: 4K field cameras, aerial drones, multiple underwater cameras with housings and lighting.
- Area: based in Southern California; travels for projects elsewhere.
- Who is behind it: Randy Beard, a swimming pool and construction defect expert witness in the trade since 1979 (https://exteriorart.com). VarX's construction-defect exhibits draw on that background.
- How to start: email or call with the location, what needs to be shown, how it will be used, and the deadline. Projects are discussed and quoted directly; prices are not published on the site.
